# Deep Learning in NLP

Deep learning architectures have revolutionized the field of natural language processing.
Traditional approaches relied heavily on hand-crafted features and statistical language models.

## Transformers and Self-Attention

The introduction of the Transformer architecture by Vaswani et al. in 2017 marked a paradigm shift.
Transformers leverage multi-head self-attention mechanisms to model relationships between tokens regardless of positional distance.
This architecture enables massive parallelization during training compared to recurrent neural networks (RNNs).
